calibration: per checkpoint: temperature (p7_eval.fit_temperature) + admission threshold (P8 rule) on validation only; no test refit
catalogue: family tokens (p13_scenes.TOK); every scene edit = a D parking subset of the pool (pairs: A, B, A+B; triples: all 7)
dedup: stable geometry + fingerprint against P10a / P10b / P11 / P12 / every earlier P13 plan; parent lineage = root (no derived roots)

execution.order: jobs in one frozen random root permutation (seed 13) across all executable blind roots, interleaving families, so coverage under the cap is outcome-blind and not batch-prefix biased
execution.protocol: strict TOP1_COMMIT, one episode per distinct (root, repair), 180 CPU-s / 600 s, no fallback, SAFE_RETREAT; G+M planner-assisted <= 5 candidates reported separately

generator.conditioning: mechanism-conditioned case-control: sound-certificate / pose-screen INTENT predicates per family (recorded per root, never a learner input); NAT = unconditioned natural stream (no prescreen)
dev_revisions: V1: near-start barrier rule after the first probe (DEV)
V1.1: PC_SERIAL prediction-only after DEV pilot 2

not_run.TRI_OR: 0 / 2 DEV lattices complete at the teacher budget (Delta_ABC = -1 NOT_EVALUATED)

p12_continuation: frozen P12 jobs only, frozen order, cap 9,000 CPU-s; supplementary, never P13 confirmation

primary.H_F2: B vs B-F2: per-root mean accuracy P(good) > P(bad) over proof-grounded same-endpoint reversed-order pairs (seed-mean marginals)
primary.H_F3: B vs B-F3pm: per-root joint four-bit log-loss -log P_S(z0, zS[A], zS[B], zS[A+B] = observed), mean over 3 seeds; cohort = proof-grounded pair four-tuples of the BLIND CHALLENGE set (all kappa classes)
primary.H_F4: B vs B-F4: per-root mean omission log-loss over proof-grounded omissions of VERIFIED >= 2-move repairs (seed-mean marginals)
primary.H_F5: B vs B-F5spm: same endpoint and cohort
primary.family: Holm over exactly these 4 tests, alpha 0.05, two-sided exact sign test (ties removed), unit = independent root, paired root bootstrap 95 % CI (2,000 resamples, seed 0)

roster.rule: p13_pipeline.roster(): seeds 2026160000+ (train), 2026170000+ (validation), 2026180000+ (blind challenge), 2026190000+ (natural blind); families interleaved; batches of <= 16

safety_and_secondary: kappa MAE (seed-mean estimand) on kappa = +1 roots and false-interaction rate (|khat| >= 0.5) on kappa = 0 roots; constant-zero control
same comparisons with the plain off arms (B-F3, B-F5s, B-F5q) - capacity attribution
F5q: B vs B-F5q(pm) on |Delta_hat_ABC - Delta_ABC| and joint 8-bit log-loss over complete proof-grounded triple lattices (>= 12 required)
F1: static-validity AUROC / AUPRC on held-out analytic static checks, B vs B-F1off; deployment path reported (veto / tie counts)
J: travel regret among admitted, VERIFIED, equal-move alternatives with witnessed travel (B vs no-J vs shuffled-J); success non-inferiority
vision B vs B-V0; keying B vs B-U; A / C / SF on every endpoint; natural-mix replication of every primary
strict TOP1 executed success (frozen choices, no fallback) and G+M separately

D / D-pairless / geometry: initial feasibility (natural set has feasible originals) and blocker union F1 / exact on exact lattices; A / B / C / SF attribution on the same lattices with NO_PREDICTED_CLEARING_SET scored as a miss
secondary_multiplicity: Holm within each secondary family; never promoted to confirmed
stopping: fixed roster and budget; no interim significance look; unavailable / censored roots are reported, never replaced

teacher.adjudication: unchanged OPNEG-v1; VERIFIED / CERTIFIED (scoped) / BUDGET (operational) / UNKNOWN / NOT_RUN

policy.change_vs_P10B_S100_V1: a censored seed no longer ends the query: the remaining declared seeds run (still 100 CPU-s each, 330 CPU-s per query, 900 CPU-s per root); adjudication unchanged (OPNEG-v1)

training.D: D / D-pairless, lambda_B in {0.5, 1, 2} x 3 seeds, 600 updates; lambda_B by mean validation NLL
training.data: P10c trainval records + P13 train / validation
training.selection: lowest validation root NLL every 20 updates (P10b + P13 validation)

verdict_rule: SUPPORTED_CONDITIONAL only if Holm p < 0.05, mean effect >= the minimal effect, 95 % CI excludes 0, AND no significant harm (raw p < 0.05 in the harmful direction) on (i) kappa = 0 false-interaction rate (F3 / F5), (ii) the natural-mix version of the same endpoint; else NO_DEMONSTRATED_BENEFIT / HARMFUL (significant reversal) / UNDERPOWERED (< 12 roots)
